content:
We have a new release candidate of Lean, v4.33.0-rc2. See the release notes for more information.

The usual repos are all available with the new toolchain at their respective v4.33.0-rc2 tags (and ProofWidgets at v0.0.107). We encourage all projects downstream to update to v4.33.0-rc2 when possible, and to release their own corresponding
toolchain tags after updating.

The difference to v4.33.0-rc1 is mostly kernel fixes and improvements.
